006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathException;
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.INodeItem;
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
012
013/**
014 * This interface provides an entry point for performing validations over
015 * Metapath items associated with a Metaschema model.
016 * <p>
017 * Implementations may hold resources such as thread pools that must be released
018 * when validation is complete. Callers should use try-with-resources or
019 * explicitly call {@link #close()} when done with the validator.
020 */
021public interface IConstraintValidator extends AutoCloseable {
022  /**
023   * Validate the provided item against any associated constraints.
024   *
025   * @param item
026   *          the item to validate
027   * @param dynamicContext
028   *          the Metapath dynamic execution context to use for Metapath
029   *          evaluation
030   * @throws ConstraintValidationException
031   *           if a constraint violation is detected
032   * @throws MetapathException
033   *           if an error occurred while evaluating a Metapath used in a
034   *           constraint
035   */
036  void validate(
037      @NonNull INodeItem item,
038      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException;
039
040  /**
041   * Complete any validations that require full analysis of the content model.
042   *
043   * @param dynamicContext
044   *          the Metapath dynamic execution context to use for Metapath
045   *          evaluation
046   * @throws ConstraintValidationException
047   *           if a constraint violation is detected during finalization
048   * @throws MetapathException
049   *           if an error occurred while evaluating a Metapath used in a
050   *           constraint
051   */
052  void finalizeValidation(@NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException;
053
054  /**
055   * Release any resources held by this validator.
056   * <p>
057   * This method should be called when the validator is no longer needed to
058   * release resources such as thread pools. For validators using sequential
059   * execution, this method does nothing.
060   */
061  @Override
062  void close();
063}
